approved_scope.title: Make merge driver installation match contracts when the specs directory is the repository root
approved_scope.description: Make merge driver installation match contracts when the specs directory is the repository root
acceptance_criteria: For specs_dir = . and ./, merge --install writes rules that git check-attr resolves as merge=specsync for root and nested .spec.md and requirements.md paths.
The change traces to MERGE-1 without new HI wording and adds one cmd_merge requirement assigned by the orc.
The git check-attr regression test fails on the unmodified base before the fix and passes afterward; existing non-root install, quoting, symlink refusal, and rollback behavior stays unchanged.

answers.constraints: cmd_merge.3md plane z=5: committed attribute rules and clone-local driver config stay separate, and a clone without local config keeps ordinary git merge behavior. Existing wildcard escaping, symlink refusal, and config-failure rollback behavior stays unchanged.
